name: Sheets
description: A small, painfully shy bedsheet ghost who whispers indie lullabies into the mic and is always slightly astonished anyone is listening.
build: Small and soft, a single rounded dome-headed shape under the sheet with narrow sloping shoulders and two small arm shapes lifting the cloth from inside, standing upright and level like the rest of the roster; the hem rests on the floor all round, never hovering, with no feet or legs visible.
face: Two plain oval eyeholes cut in the sheet near the top of the dome, showing soft dark shadow with two tiny pale glints for eyes, and a small soft oval mouth-hole below them that is his mouth: it opens wider, rounds and narrows as he sings, dark inside.
hair: None; the dome of the sheet is smooth.
outfit: One plain off-white cotton bedsheet draped over the whole body, soft and slightly rumpled, with a faint pale-blue pinstripe, gentle folds falling to a wavy hem that pools a little on the floor, and one small faded blue star-shaped patch sewn near the lower character-right side.
personality: Shy, gentle and sincere; blushes through the cloth.
performance_style: Small and hushed: the dome tipped slightly down, the free character-left arm shape lifted to hold the sheet edge up near the mouth-hole, the hem settled on the floor.
location: A child's attic bedroom at night: a floor of pale painted floorboards with a round braided rug running to the bottom of the frame, a clean back wall of sloping plaster with faded star wallpaper, a small iron bed with a rumpled quilt and a stack of old books at one side, and a round window showing a small crescent moon. Soft blue night-light glow and a warm lamp pool.
recognition_cues: a small off-white bedsheet ghost with two oval eyeholes
a small round mouth-hole below the eyeholes
a faint pale-blue pinstripe and one faded blue star patch
a wavy hem resting on the floor
avoid: floating, hovering, a tail or a hem lifted off the floor
visible feet, legs, shoes, hands or a person under the sheet
a translucent, glowing or wispy spectral ghost
a hooded robe, chains, a scream mask or a menacing face
a teddy bear, candle or blanket in hand
high kicks, knee lifts or jumps

animations.dance: Shy indie sway loop: from the hushed stance, rock the whole sheeted body gently to character-right with the dome tilting and the folds swinging, pause, rock to character-left, give a tiny bashful shoulder shrug under the cloth, and settle back into the exact opening stance with the hem resting on the floor throughout.

sing.intent: Whispered lullaby loop: lean the dome in close to the mic with the eyeholes softly narrowing, sway a little as the free arm shape lifts gently out to the side, then draw back into his hushed stance. The small mouth-hole in the sheet is his mouth and must visibly open, round and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief room-sound startle: the whole sheet puffs up and ripples, the eyeholes go round and the free arm shape pulls the cloth up over the mouth-hole, then it settles and he resettles into his hushed stance, hem on the floor. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: turn one shoulder forward and lift the free arm shape so a fold of the sheet covers the eyeholes, peeking over its edge, then hold a steady upright finish with the hem on the floor. Not a combat action.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: shuffle in with small gliding steps under the hem, stop, peek out at the crowd, give a tiny wave with the free arm shape, then settle into his hushed stance.
animations.victory: One-shot song-finish celebration: lift both arm shapes up in a small happy stretch so the sheet rises into a tall point at the dome, sway once with a pink blush showing through the cloth, then hold a proud upright pose with the hem on the floor.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: he stays upright while his nerve goes — the dome droops forward, both arm shapes drop so the sheet hangs limp and straight, and the eyeholes sag into sad downturned ovals. He holds a standing, visibly crestfallen finish with the hem resting on the floor. He remains upright in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, deflating into a flat pile of cloth or going to the ground. Do not imply a hit, injury or opponent.
